rowPolicy.new-owner: Required, not yet covered. Evidence IDs must be added after authoring and complete-task review.
rowPolicy.verified-existing: Only the named operation and evidence IDs are reused; easier levels and existing objects remain unchanged.
rowPolicy.support-reference-only: Explained or linked, not claimed as exercise coverage.
rowPolicy.deferred: Outside the practical extension; a significant new exclusion needs owner agreement.
rowPolicy.contextKeys: Planned semantic contexts until matched to authored IDs. Paired forms/interpretations and mere numeral/noun substitutions share a key.
rowPolicy.review: All61 denominator rows and97 lexical dispositions accepted within the independent matrix/reuse/exclusion scope after F1-F7 reconciliation; new runtime content still requires complete-task acceptance.
rowPolicy.completion: Required new rows need actual source-backed runtime IDs, per-record operation/context/level evidence, reconciled text review and importer acceptance. E checks the combined denominator.
rowPolicy.level: Counter level 3 is an editorial practical allocation unless an exact source spelling/reading/sense is explicitly identified. Grammar levels follow complete constructions, never this allocation.

sources.publisher: stephenmk/yomitan-jlpt-vocab community distribution; repository sense audit
sources.scope: Exact source_id, source spelling/reading, original gloss, mapped article/entry/senses and documented corrections. The lexical screening below retains source identity rather than changing the TSV.
sources.limits: Community, not official JLPT. A noun sense, homograph or different reading does not assign every numeric counter use to N3.

sources.scope: PDF pages 5 (課, organizational section), 17 (人数), 18 (半年, 半分, 番目, 半), 19 (便 flight label; 部 department), 21 (万), 22 (約). Original page numbers, not printed topic numbers.
sources.limits: Practical pre-intermediate relevance, not N3 equivalence. Organizational 課/部 entries are not evidence for lesson counts or printed copies. This source assembled the matrix and cannot serve as its additional independent-reference check.

sources.scope: Sino-Japanese number construction, zero, hundreds/thousands sound changes, 万/億/兆, mixed notation and digit-by-digit identifiers.
sources.limits: Usage, not JLPT allocation. No need for every large unit or formal/obsolete reading.

sources.scope: 冊/枚/匹/頭 and 課 sections and number tables; lesson counts versus numbered lessons.
sources.limits: Do not turn size preferences into an absolute 頭/匹 partition. Bare numbered 課 can be a label or count depending on context.

sources.scope: Native counter sections: 品, 桁, 切れ, 房, 袋, 箱, 棟, 組, 皿, 束, 通り, 駅; primary native-number versus class-label distinctions.
sources.limits: Consequential alternate readings need targeted corroboration before grading. No blanket adoption of every listed variant or English gloss. Bundles have no fixed universal contents.

sources.scope: 名, 羽, 部, 戸, 人前, 丁, 点, 泊, 通, 巻, 錠 sections and tables.
sources.limits: 錠 counts tablets, not dosage events. 部 copies is distinct from a department or an abstract part. 羽 variants must be checked for each canonical number, not generated from a single rule.

sources.scope: 件, 行, 種類, 脚, 膳 and pair-counter 対/つい sections. The complete page does not teach ratio 対/たい; do not cite it for that sense.
sources.limits: A table's specialist units are not all practical N3 targets. Bank 行/こう is not text-line 行/ぎょう. Broad English explanations are not unrestricted substitution rules.

sources.scope: 何+counter versus indefinite 何+counter+か; 数 prefixes; counter+数 quantity names; 半 and 余/余り.
sources.limits: 数 does not impose a universal exact 2-10 range. The English rendering of 数十枚 loses the tens distinction and is not adopted.

sources.scope: Denominator+分の+numerator, mixed-number と, decimal reading, 割 and 割引.
sources.limits: Reject the opening claim that decimals must lie between 0 and 1 and the exclusive zero=ゼロ claim. Existing れい/ゼロ alternatives remain. Traditional fraction units do not all become core.

sources.scope: Adjacent-number approximations with and without counters; 二、三百; 三、四時間; forms with explicit か.
sources.limits: Do not treat approximate expressions as exact closed mathematical intervals. Retain the requested unit's reading and avoid unusual variants without corroboration.

sources.scope: Opening through generic ordering, 番/番目 and emphatic 第 sections: numbered lessons/chapters/episodes, rank 位, ordinal suffix 目, labels 号室/番線.
sources.limits: The inspected segment does not verify every later section. Context distinguishes labels, rankings and counts; 第 is not mandatory for every label.

sources.scope: Hours, minutes and seconds tables, optional 間 for minute/second durations, evening/night distinctions.
sources.limits: No universal equivalence between a calendar stay and elapsed hours; source's stylistic simplifications are not categorical bans.

sources.scope: Everyday SI length, mass, 秒, capacity L/mL, metric トン, speed distinctions and the separation from traditional units.
sources.limits: A mixed technical survey, not a practical frequency ranking. Technical spoken unit variants and obsolete conversions are not adopted wholesale.

sources.scope: Pronunciation table, large mammals, professional animals and overlap with 匹; first 12000 extracted characters.
sources.limits: Independent usage/readings corroboration, not JLPT evidence. Do not copy the lifting-size mnemonic as a strict grammatical test; remainder of page was not part of this inspection.

sources.scope: 箱 entry: 一箱ひとはこ; 個/箱; flattened cardboard boxes can be 枚; specialized 折/合.
sources.limits: Object-count alternatives depend on physical state. This entry corroborates ひとはこ, not every number in a 箱 paradigm.

sources.publisher: Shogakukan Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten, via Kotobank
sources.scope: 十数/じゅうすう word element; both entries specify 10 or more and fewer than 20.
sources.limits: Do not impose a conflicting exclusive lower bound on graded choices. This is not a definition of 数十 or an exact count.

sources.publisher: Shogakukan Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten, via Kotobank

sources.publisher: Shogakukan Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten, via Kotobank

sources.limits: Do not silently conflate ordinary native forms with specialist りゅう readings, historical money or percussion senses.

sources.publisher: Shogakukan Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten, via Kotobank

sources.scope: Actual quantity-scope/zutsu task bodies, five particle-neighbors quantity items, six means-and-scope rank items and comparison-set items were inspected, not inferred from titles.

rows.forms: Decimal length/weight and signed temperature

rows.forms: Whole-number パーセント

rows.support: Original explicit rate cues.

rows.forms: 割, 割引, 半額 and simple percentage/discount forms

rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: 対/たい and 倍
rows.misconception: A ratio is not a count of physical pairs; double the base is not an increase by twice the base.
rows.support: State order of compared quantities and base.

rows.forms: 数, 数十/数百, 十数 and non-interrogative 何百-type magnitude

rows.misconception: 数十/十数 differ; non-interrogative 何百 can express hundreds, not an exact unknown count. Make the statement/question context visible.
rows.support: Explicit requested form; no answer revealing gloss in interpretation tasks.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: 約/およそ, adjacent-number estimates and 数量+程度
rows.misconception: An estimate is not an exact measurement or universally closed interval.
rows.support: Constrain notation; reuse existing approximation grammar rather than duplicate it.

rows.forms: 頭
rows.misconception: Animal size is a preference, not an absolute 頭/匹 boundary.
rows.support: Inline unfamiliar animal reading/gloss; no animal reverse distractors.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: 羽/わ
rows.misconception: The N3 羽/はね word is not source membership for counter わ.
rows.support: Practical editorial allocation; document exact accepted variants before authoring.

rows.forms: Printed copies 部 versus sheets 枚/bound books 冊
soundClasses: いちぶ not いっぷ
rows.misconception: One multi-page copy need not be one sheet; copies and physical books can overlap.
rows.support: Make binding/whole-copy facts explicit; accept applicable 冊/組/セット alternatives.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: 通 versus sheets/copies
rows.misconception: A message and its pages/copies are different counting units.
rows.support: Simple document glosses; avoid ambiguous generic document reverse nouns.

rows.forms: 箱 versus contents/flat cardboard
rows.misconception: A boxful is not the count of individual items; flattened boxes may take 枚.
rows.support: Explicit physical state; no hidden package size.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: 袋
rows.misconception: Bag count does not establish weight or contents without a package label.
rows.support: Native ordinary forms; no industrial タイ claim.

rows.forms: 皿 food servings versus 枚 plates
rows.misconception: A plateful of food and a flat empty plate are different units.
rows.support: State food/empty-plate sense; retain fitting alternatives.

rows.forms: 組 sets/groups versus class labels
rows.misconception: Number of groups, members per group and a school-class identifier differ; 人組 has its own new row.
rows.support: Show membership where relevant; label/count instruction visible.

rows.forms: 束/たば
rows.misconception: A bundle has no universal fixed number of pieces; archaic つか is not たば.
rows.support: Support bundled-item words; keep ソク specialist usage separate.

rows.forms: 粒/つぶ
rows.misconception: Grains and their packages are different units.
rows.support: Harmless object counts, not medical dosing; reference りゅう without conflation.

rows.forms: 錠
rows.misconception: A tablet count is not a number of doses or a dosage recommendation.
rows.support: Inventory/label scenarios only; explain 錠.

rows.forms: 件 versus 軒
rows.misconception: Case 件 is not building 軒 and does not inherit 三軒 voicing.
rows.support: Support event/case nouns; avoid noun-only reverse ambiguity.

rows.forms: 品/ひん and native 品/しな
rows.misconception: The separate noun 品/しな does not automatically supply every counter reading.
rows.support: Grade canonical displayed form with checked alternatives, not an absolute sense partition.

rows.forms: 戸 housing units and 棟 buildings
soundClasses: native むね alternatives as applicable
rows.misconception: One building can contain several homes; 軒 alternatives do not already teach that contrast.
rows.support: State what is counted and the building/unit relation; verify native variants before use.

rows.forms: 課/章 counts and 第 labels; section 節
rows.misconception: Lesson 3 does not establish three completed lessons; source 節/ふし is not counter せつ.
rows.support: Explicit count/label request; section usage needs exact supporting entry before authoring.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: 話 episode labels and 巻 volumes versus 冊
rows.misconception: Volume number is not the number of books owned; one volume can have several copies.
rows.support: Name the requested label/count, not a universal 冊/巻 exclusivity rule.

rows.forms: 位/い, 級 and 段
rows.misconception: A rank or grade label is not a count; unlike ranks, grading systems need not have the same ordering.
rows.support: Do not infer universal grade hierarchy; exact suffix senses/readings checked during authoring.

rows.forms: 人前 portions, 点 merchandise and scores, 種類 kinds
soundClasses: いちにんまえ/ににんまえ
rows.misconception: Servings are not diners; merchandise item counts and scores use different meanings of 点. 人分 has a separate row.
rows.support: Simple menu/shop scenarios; define item/type aggregation visibly.

rows.forms: 切れ and 房
rows.misconception: A slice/bunch is not the entire cake or one grape.
rows.support: Physical form shown in words; accept natural piece alternatives.

rows.forms: 桁, 行 and 字/文字, including explicitly stated 以内 character limits
rows.misconception: Digit count is not digit place; 以内 includes the stated upper limit. C writes/reads the expression, while D owns boundary interpretation.
rows.support: Specify Arabic digit strings or Japanese characters; no Unicode implementation trivia.

rows.forms: 便 labels versus services counted
rows.misconception: Flight 205 is not 205 flights; source 便/びん is not way/means.
rows.support: Use a stated Japanese unit notation; avoid pretending every airline reads identifiers identically.

rows.forms: 株 share/plant counts
rows.misconception: Share count is not share price; a rooted plant is not a cut stem.
rows.support: Existing words/株.md entry 1208920 senses 1-3 inspected; simple counting only, not investment advice or finance calculations.

rows.forms: 番/号 labels and ～目
rows.misconception: A label and an ordinal/quantity are different operations.
rows.support: Original explicit cues.

rows.forms: 足/着/軒/名/回/度/泊
rows.misconception: An N3 vocabulary-list occurrence does not require duplicating easier drills.
rows.support: Existing context-qualified alternatives.

rows.forms: Dates, 24-hour times, hours/minutes and years/months
rows.misconception: Calendar months are not fixed day counts; clock time is not duration.
rows.support: Existing full context and constrained notation.

rows.forms: 秒, 分秒 and manageable sub-minute durations
rows.misconception: Seconds are not minutes; a component is not the entire duration.
rows.support: Group time; explicit duration notation, no stopwatch locale ambiguity.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: Age/year 代/年代, numerical 台 bands and 世紀
rows.misconception: A band is not an exact value; a numbered century is not an arbitrary hundred-year span.
rows.support: Existing words/世紀.md entry 1373990 inspected. State conventional notation, and keep calendar versus everyday group placement explicit.

rows.forms: リットル/ミリリットル and metric トン
rows.misconception: Metric ton is 1000 kg, not 1000 tons; rare 屯 is not the default writing.
rows.support: Request the unit rather than require mental conversion; preserve easier g/kg drills.

rows.forms: 時速/秒速 with ordinary metric units
rows.misconception: Rate is not total distance; omitted everyday units depend on context.
rows.support: State full units; avoid specialist technical reading variants.

rows.forms: Bounds, benchmarks, indefinite counts, frequency and price/time frames
rows.misconception: Boundary, frequency, duration and price scopes cannot be inferred from a number alone.
rows.support: All 28 baseline quantity-scope tasks inspected; exact record hashes in baseline inventory.

rows.forms: ずつ per-unit, total and incremental implications
rows.misconception: The total need not equal each unit's amount; repeated activity need not be simultaneous or unfinished.
rows.support: All 16 existing tasks inspected; preserve their N3 levels.

rows.forms: Approximate quantity versus exclusive limit
rows.misconception: Approximation is not だけ restriction; quantity approximators need not be universally interchangeable.
rows.support: Original visible operation and fitting alternatives.

rows.forms: Comparison set and の次に relative rank
rows.misconception: Next after X is not necessarily second overall; the stated comparison domain matters.
rows.support: Tie/domain facts explicit in existing tasks.

rows.forms: Part/whole, reduction amount and amount left
rows.misconception: The removed part and remaining whole are different quantities.
rows.support: Small transparent arithmetic; protect tested amount/construction from vocabulary gloss; per-task source level.
rows.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

rows.forms: Ratio order, base and rate versus total
rows.misconception: A ratio needs an ordered comparison and a rate does not supply an unstated total.
rows.support: No complex arithmetic; exact whole-task level evidence rather than N3-by-project.

rows.forms: 数十/十数; non-interrogative 何百-type magnitude; approximate versus established amount
rows.misconception: A vague report does not establish an exact number; 十数 is not 数十.
rows.support: Avoid disputed edge boundaries and answer-leaking glosses; classify actual tested construction.

rows.forms: 合計/平均/残り/率/量/金額/単位 and related numerical vocabulary
rows.misconception: A word article is not numerical interpretation practice; arithmetic algorithms are not language outcomes.
rows.support: Use established word links or inline glosses without giving away target operations.

rows.forms: Reference boundary: fractional 厘/毛, historical 勺/升/斗/石 and 匁/貫, detailed 尺貫法 conversion tables, formal 壱/弐/参, and 京/垓 or higher magnitudes
soundClasses: do not generate a complete paradigm
rows.misconception: A finite reference-only boundary is not a claim that every traditional unit is rare. Ordinary housing area, rice 合 and recipe measures now have required rows.
rows.support: Explain recognition and link sources without claiming exercises or frequency measurements. No blanket exclusion of an entire measurement system.
rows.ownerDecision: No owner agreement is asserted. This narrows the pre-existing technical/historical reference-only boundary and includes the practical candidates. Independent reconciliation must decide whether any remaining boundary is a significant new exclusion; if so obtain actual owner agreement before bulk work.

rows.forms: Specialist finance/science calculations and medical dosing
rows.misconception: Language-unit practice is not specialist professional instruction.
rows.support: Original parent scope excludes a full specialist course; ordinary discounts, metric tons and inventory counts remain required.

rows.forms: 人分 quantities for people versus served 人前
rows.misconception: A quantity intended for people does not count the people themselves or necessarily correspond to restaurant servings.
rows.support: Support recipe/material nouns; no scaling arithmetic required.

rows.forms: 丁 for tofu blocks
soundClasses: はっちょう; verify accepted variants
rows.misconception: A marketed pack, a tofu block and a cut piece need not be the same unit.
rows.support: Food context only; no firearm or other specialist 丁 senses.

rows.forms: 部屋 room counts versus 号室 identifiers
rows.misconception: Rooms, dwelling units, buildings and room labels are different quantities.
rows.support: Supply any accommodation vocabulary; exact readings/variants require the batch usage check.

rows.forms: 人組 membership size versus number of 組
rows.misconception: A three-person group is not three groups; do not conflate membership with class labels.
rows.support: Use an explicit request for member count or group count, not inferred hidden context.

rows.forms: Numerical 通り/とおり for ways and readings
soundClasses: さんとおり; verify contextual variants
rows.misconception: Ways are not passages/copies 通 or street/as-stated 通り; no inherited N3 sense claim.
rows.support: State the number directly; no combinatorics calculation.

rows.forms: 以内 numerical/character/time upper bounds
rows.misconception: 以内 includes the boundary, unlike a strict below/before reading; the counted unit remains explicit.
rows.support: Existing bounds owner with additive facets only if needed; exact whole-task level source must be inspected.

rows.forms: 年ぶり and month/year interval before a repeated event
rows.misconception: A gap before a repeated event is not the event duration or a calendar year label.
rows.support: D authors bounded counter expressions and existing time-frame interpretations, not a new Grammar engine. Verify exact Bunpro placement before assigning a Grammar level.

rows.forms: 位/くらい for digit place, distinct from 桁 digit count
soundClasses: 百の位/ひゃくのくらい
rows.misconception: Place, number of digits, approximate suffix くらい and ranking suffix 位/い are separate.

rows.forms: 平方メートル, 畳/じょう and 坪 in stated housing area
rows.misconception: Area, room count and floor/room identifiers differ; do not assert one exact universal physical tatami size.
rows.support: Bounded production/reading of stated measurements, not land surveying or exact traditional-to-metric conversions.

rows.forms: 合 for stated uncooked-rice volume
rows.misconception: Volume is not an invariant mass or cooked yield; a rice measuring cup is not automatically an ordinary cup.

rows.forms: 歳 age, 二十歳 and 階 floor identifiers
rows.misconception: Age, age bands and a floor identifier are distinct; existing tasks are not newly level3.
rows.support: Reuse original age/floor records without edits.
